## Empty GEOGRAPHY values
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# ST_ISEMPTY documents the equivalence of empty shapes; ST_CLUSTERDBSCAN shows their canonical
# WKT. The individual function descriptions specify empty inputs, counts, measures and errors.
# Exact error messages, GeoJSON formatting and spheroid validation order come from BigQuery's
# answers to unverified cases.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOLYGON EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(wkt) FROM UNNEST([' point  empty ']) AS wkt
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "ST_GeometryCollection"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "-1"

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_NPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_NPOINTS(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_AREA(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(NULL, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(NULL, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 1000)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1000)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1000)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL, 1000)
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(NULL, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1000)
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(NULL, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: Argument to ST_X must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: Argument to ST_Y must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: S2_CellIdFromPoint: Argument to S2CellIdFromPoint must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> error: ST_Azimuth: Argument to STAzimuth must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: ST_Azimuth: Argument to STAzimuth must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: ST_Azimuth: Argument to STAzimuth must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 8)
=> null

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), NULL)
=> null

CREATE TEMP TABLE empty_geo AS SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY') AS g; SELECT g FROM empty_geo
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

# An EMPTY token must finish the WKT; SAFE. handles the resulting input error.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY x')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected end of data, but saw 'x' at position 12.

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(wkt) FROM UNNEST(['GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY x']) AS wkt
=> null

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "{ \"type\": \"GeometryCollection\", \"geometries\": [ ] } "

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY x')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected end of data, but saw 'x' at position 25.

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), TRUE)
=> error: ST_LENGTH does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), TRUE)
=> error: ST_AREA does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), TRUE)
=> error: ST_PERIMETER does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 1, TRUE)
=> error: ST_DWITHIN does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null
